text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm on my way to the track for training,
when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hup... Hnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Uuugh, I can't reach it...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heya, Rice! What's got you jumping
around?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh, Gold Ship!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, my handkerchief flew off in the
wind, and
now it's caught on a tree
branch.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I getcha. Thought you were getting
some
jump rope practice in or
something.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I haven't had much luck jumping...
I'd be able
to reach if only I were a little
taller...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Now, listen here! The Rice I know isn't
someone
who whines about her size.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I've had my eye on you, pardner... You
kept on
losing, yet you still continued to
race.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You're always facing your goals head-on!
That
unwavering persistence of yours is a
strength!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Don't give up! Jump and grab that
handkerchief!
Grab your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes... You're right! I'm gonna keep at it
no matter
what!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower jumps with all her might,
over and
over again, until finally...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-I got it?! I did it! I got the
handkerchief!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Wow, that was impressive! Congrats!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy for you, Rice!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Clap, clap, clap!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hweh?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the blink of an eye, a crowd
assembles to
shower Rice Shower in
praise.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whaddya think, Rice? Your efforts have
touched
everyone here!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The will to not give up... The courage to
keep
fighting! You're the best
Umamusume the world's
ever seen!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... I'm not sure what you mean, but
if
everyone's happy, I guess I am too.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
All right! Now,
I'll take that handkerchief off ya!
I'm tacking on an extra fifty
centimeters for your
next challenge!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whaa?! But it took me ages just to get it once!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The importance of continuing to strive
toward
your goals... It's a message that
works just as well
for trainers.
